title: The dark side of AI-generated deepfakes

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if your voice could be used to steal millions?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Deepfakes are already being weaponized in financial fraud.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s AI that can clone someone’s voice in seconds, fooling even experts.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The tool, called “Synthesia,” can create realistic videos with just a text prompt.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Victims lose money, and trust in institutions is shattered.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Remember: AI can mimic, but it can’t replace real human connection.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you seen a deepfake that changed your opinion?

caption_text: The dark side of AI-generated deepfakes
